input: Photograph every room for a home inventory record

gold.taskTitle: Photograph Every Room for Home Inventory Record
gold.taskDescription: Systematically photograph all rooms and their contents to create a complete home inventory record.

questions.title: Is this inventory for insurance, selling, or moving?
questions.description: Understanding the purpose will shape how detailed and formal the photos need to be.

questions.title: How many rooms does your home have?
questions.description: Knowing the scope helps estimate time and effort required to complete the project.

questions.title: Which specific items must be individually photographed?
questions.description: Some inventories require item-level shots of valuables like jewelry, electronics, or art.

questions.title: What device will you use to take the photos?
questions.description: Knowing whether you have a smartphone, tablet, or camera affects photo quality and storage planning.

questions.title: Where will the finished photos be stored or backed up?
questions.description: Determines whether you need cloud storage, a physical drive, or a specific inventory app.

questions.title: Do you need a specific format for the final record?
questions.description: Some insurance providers or legal uses require a spreadsheet, PDF report, or timestamped video.

questions.title: By what date does this inventory need to be completed?
questions.description: A deadline helps prioritize rooms and set a realistic shooting schedule.
